notes.title: Deadzone: Rogue Patch Notes | 1.0.0.18
notes.notes:
Synergies

Players can now shoot, throw grenades, and throw barrels through the Dome Shield synergy.

Dome Shield Synergy will now work if your shield goes to 0 from Darkseer, or any other ability that brings your shield down to 0 without actually damaging you. It will not activate if you have Temp Shield still up

Fixes

Fixed an issue where the Epic Beginnings reward item was not applying on some missions.

Fixed an issue where the timer on Sector 20 of Killing Time did not show the timer. 

Fixed an issue where dashing while holding forward would stump the player’s height. 

Fixed an issue where the Meteor Shard item would not activate its effect if Flux was applied to the enemy.

Fixed an issue where Plasma Bloom perk incorrectly applied Flux indefinitely if an enemy died from it.

Fixed an issue where Smart Rockets can incur the Handyman synergy cost if your grenade is on cooldown.

Fixed an issue where the Switchblade bot would sometimes teleport instead of dash.

Fixed an issue where the Boomerang super item was not applying its effect to the Nova Burst. 

Fixed an issue the in world character nameplate and health bar would be visible in 1st person while spectating a player.

Fixed an issue where the upgrade reminder prompt was not showing. This prompt can be disabled in the Settings menu. 

Fixed inconsistencies with the name of the Deadeye bot. 

Fixed an issue where deadzone for the right thumbstick would not properly clamp after surpassing 50. 

Fixed an issue where aim acceleration was never being applied.

notes.title: Full 1.0 Release + 20% Discount Start Now! Zone 3 is LIVE.
notes.notes:
1.0 Launch is LIVE!

[previewyoutube=23DDZhMHUog;full][/previewyoutube]
A huge THANK YOU to everyone for your feedback and support during the demo and early access!

You can now wield powerful synergies in 9 all-new missions, harness new psionic and plasma elements, and battle challenging new enemies and bosses in Zone 3! An original sound track, avatars and titles, databank stat tracker, voice chat, and more have also been added to enhance your experience.

Operative Pack DLC, OST, and Deluxe Editions are now available, all at 20% off!

Zone 3 Is LIVE!

Our Largest Ever Content Update

 Over 20 new enemies, with a huge range of abilities
 Two unique mini-bosses to survive and outsmart
 A special large-scale boss battle that is our toughest yet
 New synergy system with 40+ options to enhance your builds
 Two new elements to harness - psionic and plasma!
 New Zone 3 environment with a bio-organic feel
 Several new weapons - two exotic, one melee
 New story lines, lore logs, and much more

9 New Missions to Conquer

 Get Out of My Head
 Legion
 Killing Time
 Uniform Chaos III
 Spearhead
 Triggerline
 Harbinger
 The Long Haul
 Crossfire

Major Improvements in All Areas

 New original soundtrack for Zones 1, 2, and 3
 New avatar and title systems for player profile
 Six new perk families to spice up your build
 Voice chat for co-op and other improvements
 New audio localization in Chinese and Japanese
 Codex to track lifetime statistics (Databank)
 Lore log console and expanded glossary screen
 Achieved official verified status on Steam Deck
 Gamepad support for text chat, fabricator, weapon select
 Co-op join codes are now shorter and easier to use
 Various performance improvements and fixes
 Reticle customization and quality of life changes
 Unique avatar and title given to Early Access players


Operative Pack,  OST, Deluxe Edition Now Available


 The Operative Pack DLC has some awesome new cosmetic content to up your style
 Includes Void King weapon skins and suit, lounge with jukebox, golden name, and more
 Great if you want to bling out a bit, no gameplay influence
 20% off now, and for next 2 weeks!

 The OST (Original Sound Track) DLC has 15 new original songs for the game
 Includes the full set of audio files that you can listen to and enjoy anytime
 All original music will also be in-game, to help amplify your experience
 20% off now, and for next 2 weeks!

 The Deluxe Edition includes the Base Game, Operative Pack, and OST
 Will be a complete-the-set bundle, with a 10% bundle discount available
 Even if you already purchased the base game, you can still receive the bundle discount
 Deluxe Edition will be given for free to anyone who made a purchase in Starsiege: Deadzone
 We partnered with Steam to set up automatic gifting, similar to how it worked for the base game

20% Off Launch Discount is LIVE!

 20% discount is on the Deadzone: Rogue game, Operative Pack, OST, and Deluxe Edition
 This discount runs from August 11 at 17:00 UTC to August 25 at 17:00 UTC
 If you're a new player, this is a great time to pick the game up!
 Twitch drops and official new release trailer go live today

Thank You for this Opportunity

This was one of our busiest ever months at the studio, but also one of the most fun! We spent a lot of time together writing code, playing Deadzone, making balance changes, creating new art and music, finding and fixing bugs, designing new systems, coming up with crazy names, telling bad jokes, and eating LOTS of pizza.

Everyone at our studio knows just how hard it is to create a game that can achieve this level of success, and we appreciate how rare and special this opportunity is. It's been so cool to see our whole team rise up to the moment, and we really hope that all the effort shows in this patch!

Thank you again for your support and this opportunity - it's what lets us keep doing what we love, which is making awesome games together. We hope you enjoy Zone 3 and the 1.0 launch, and good luck conquering the Deadzone!

- Prophecy Team

Updates Based on Yesterday's Feedback

Fixes

 Fixed an issue where joining co-op players were not getting mission and reward progress from beating the mission
 Fixed an issue where skins equipped from the end of mission screen would not properly equip
 Fixed an issue where the Codex would sometimes displaying bots the player hasn't killed yet
 Fixed an issue where the Zone 3 completion screen would show rooms 31/32 were showing as incomplete
 Fixed an issue with the Siphon preview mesh
 Fixed an issue where the "one away" highlight for synergies would appear in the Equipment UI
 Fixed an issue where the waypoint in Brain boss between phases was between the bridges.

Balance

 Adjusted Zone 3 Story scaling to be easier
 Increased Admiral base health from 10k to 12k
 Added additional cover to several early rooms
 Added some boxes to hole in sector 6 so it is easier to escape

Weapons

 Exotic weapons only appear at Epic rarity outside of their requirement mission.
 Updated icons for the Magnum pistol, Burst Pistol, and Pulse Pistol.

General

 Added a legacy fabricator option
 Improved audio triggers in the Epilogue
 Added a return to starting ship prompt for the Zone 3 ending sequence
 Moved dedication text to the end of the bot sequence
 Updated peer to peer disclaimer message
 Voice Chat is now defaulted to open mic
 Added a setting for voice input volume. Set range for voice input and output to 0% - 200%. Voice output volume is no longer affected by master volume, and is no longer a subsetting of the master to make that clear in the settings UI).
 Defaulted Gamepad Aim Acceleration Strength to 0.5 instead of 1.0

Helpful Links

 Troubleshooting: Helpful if you're experiencing crashes or performance issues
 Discord: Great for sharing feedback and getting help on issues, or just hanging out
 Reddit: Another nice place for the community to gather, and for more info
 Free Xbox demo: Preview of the game experience, includes Zone 1 story mission
 Free PlayStation Demo: Preview of the game experience, includes Zone 1 story mission
 QQ: Great spot for Chinese users to share feedback and get help, or hang out


Free Zone 4 Expansion Coming Early 2026
Yes, the story will continue!

notes.title: Patch Notes Version 0.4.0.16
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes    
• Fixed an issue where if a player exited the game after finishing a mission, the mission sometimes would not save.

• Added some additional fail-safes for save corruption.

• Fixed an issue where the Wasp and Guardian bots would disappear when they hit the floor (i.e. frozen or impulsed).

• Fixed a potential crash that could happen if a player died and revived in a co-op run.

notes.title: Bug Fixes

Players can now log into multiplayer from inside the game. No longer requiring to be on the main menu screen for login.

Fixed an issue where the Void Strike perk could damage teammates.

Fixed an issue where bots could get permanently staggered and infinitely shoot.

Fixed an issue where Lightning Axe bots would sometimes teleport into meshes.

Fixed an issue where flying bots would sometimes disappear when knocked back.

Fixed an issue during the reveal scene in Zone 1 where joining clients would fall out of the ship.

notes.title: 20% Off for Summer Fest, and a Major Patch!
notes.notes:
Deadzone: Rogue will be discounted 20% off during Steam's Summer Sale, starting June 26th.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45207649/1171041652b84a682c9d6705abf4e5e4ae61add1.jpg"]

This discount comes with a content update packed with additional features - patch notes below!

Deadzone: Rogue Patch 0.4.0.

Added New Mission - Redline
“Hey! Who turned out the lights?!”

 New wave mission in Zone 2!
 Rewards a new Experimental weapon - Plasma Cycler

Improved Co-Op Flow & Support
We've made a wide variety of improvements to improve the co-op experience!

Updated Multiplayer Flow 
 Seamless Steam and EGS invitations added
 Added new console in the starting ship for game session management
 Offline mode: will allow no one to join your game
 Friends Only mode: will only allow friends to join
 Public mode: will publish your game to the Server Browser for anyone to join

NOTE: Multiplayer menu has been moved into a new console in the starting ship. You no longer need to click "coop" on the main menu to access multi player mode. 

Better Reconnect Capability
 If a joining player in co-op disconnects from a run, they will be prompted upon relaunching to rejoin the session. 
 Reconnecting to a run will load the player back in with the full loadout the player had when they disconnected.

Added Late Join Support
 Joining a lobby in the middle of a mission will put the player in spectate until the mission is over
 Spectating players will join when the host returns to the starting ship

More Granular Permission System
 Can now ban players from sessions
 Mute option also added
 Permission control (server browser, friends only/join code, offline) now changeable at any time
 Made several Improvements to server browser

Loot Sharing
 Players can now easily share loot by pinging it! No more picking up and dropping to share. 

Added Text Chat
We've added in-game text chat for improved multiplayer communication during co-op missions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45207649/a610b85b2cb702833730b9a9f0d5e1fe5984adc5.gif

 Quick Chat: (default Hold Middle Mouse/D-Pad Up)
 Text Chat: (default ENTER)

Twitch Drops
Weapon skin drops for the Tritek-3SB Burst Pistol and HK-Warrior Heavy Assault Rifle are live!

See https://www.deadzonerogue.com/twitch-drops for how to link your Steam/Epic account with Twitch to receive drops! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45207649/422a2e79c4adcf714bf6e11b2c8e80396501eaac.jpg

Bot Updates
 Added clearer tells for Man-Spider’s AOE jump attack
 Fixed an issue where the Flamethrower would be able to damage players through walls and floors
 Fixed an issue where the CEO Clone was missing elemental immunity.

General Gameplay
 Made the Ready-up prompt for wave based missions more clear
 Added an accessibility option for auto-shooting single shot and burst weapons
 The option to delete saves has been restored and moved to the main menu settings
 Applying an elemental activator to an enemy now always applies that element’s debuff, even if you do not have the corresponding elemental perk
 Kills from elemental activators now activate on-kill effects triggered by the affixed weapon (i.e. stealth on kill, bullet refund on kill, etc.)
 Gyro support improvements
 Added player space aiming as an alternative to the previous local space aiming
 Added an option for the gyro reset behavior to suspend input while held instead of resetting the vertical axis

Audio
 Added SFX that plays when a teammate dies or is revived.
 Made currency pickup sound attenuated and audible to other players.

Fixes
 Fixed an issue where joining clients’ starting pistol would not be visible upon loading into a mission. 
 Fixed an issue in co-op where joining players would not see the wave counter for Last Stand increase after wave 33.
 Fixed an issue where Super Items would show as level 1 if continuing from a saved run. 
 Fixed an issue in co-op where currency could not be picked up by joining players.
 Fixed an issue where continuing a saved run would offset the encounter count. 
 Fixed an issue where Planty events would not play properly while in co-op.
 Fixed a crash that would occur if an external controller was plugged in while playing on a SteamDeck.

Known Issues
 Cannot scroll friends list with gamepads. Clicking the bottom of the scroll bar works for navigating down the menu, as a temporary solution. We'll get this fixed as soon as possible!

Happy Summer Fest! 
If you have any friends that might like Deadzone, now's a great time for them to hop in! We hope this co-op experience feels even better than before for everyone.

And of course, let us know about any feedback or issues in discord.gg/deadzonerogue in #feedback anytime, thanks!

Cheers
Prophecy Team

notes.title: Balance Update for Last Stand, More Weapon Skin Reward Fixes
notes.notes:
Patch Notes - Version 0.3.0.3

Balance Changes for Last Stand
- Adjusted bot scaling based on player feedback
- Adjusted wave count in Last Stand from 60 to 40
- Mission Rewards adjusted to be rewarded for completing waves 10, 20, 30 and 40

Bug Fixes
- Fixed some edge cases where Last Stand and Gauntlet skins were not properly being granted.
- Fixed an issue where mission rewards (Augmented Fate, Equipped Fate, Epic Beginnings, Fabricator Restock) were not granting properly.
- Fixed an issue where encounters would sometimes automatically complete when entering a room.
- Fixed a softlock in Last Stand if a player died during the prepare phase.

Known Issue
- When completing Last Stand in Co-Op, players' camera may improperly adjust to the ground and other players may be invisible. Players can still exit the level through the teleporter and complete it.

Thanks everyone for the feedback and your patience, we hope you enjoy this balance and bug fix patch! We'll continue to keep an eye on Discord, Steam forums, and Reddit to keep making the game experience better, keep it coming!

- Prophecy Team

notes.title: Major Update is Live for Zombies Fest! Free Demo is Back!
notes.notes:
Patch Notes- Version 0.3.0.0

[previewyoutube=4KpIlO0AYAM;full][/previewyoutube]
 
Steam's Zombie vs Vampires Fest is starting, and we wanted to get a major update out for you now! Prepare for a new zombie wave-based mission, a new progressive difficulty mission, checkpoints for single player mode, and free weapon skin rewards for completing in-game missions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45207649/1feef48a4f7f9ec129fdd018134d92897306d49a.png

The free demo will also return to Steam during the Zombies event, from May 26th to June 2nd.
Demo players will be able to play the Zone 1 story mission solo, or in co-op with other demo or early access players, so it's a great opportunity for friends to try out Deadzone!

New Mission - Last Stand: Zone 1
Players face off against waves of Mindless. How long can you survive?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45207649/5127c44b68501d6a5b1c151dcbb291f4b240c8b2.png

New Mission - Gauntlet - Zone 2
A progressive difficulty mission. How far can you make it?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45207649/46164c782b4c19375b65ae96cdfddfa474ab86a9.jpg

Free Weapon Skins
- Weapon Skins are new cosmetics players can equip to their weapons!
- Weapon skins can be unlocked by completing missions on different difficulties
- Go to the Weapon Arsenal in the starting ship to equip them

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45207649/ec4b59d1ae26b2e4daf85cdeafb09f819f13c0c2.jpg

Save Checkpoints for Single Player Mode
- Players can now save and exit during a run by interacting with the Checkpoint Terminal in safe rooms
- Checkpoints will clear if a player hosts a co-op lobby

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45207649/b6026d4eb7080b913161d74b73b8529663d0a5a3.jpg

Free Demo Returns for Zone 1 Story Mission
- The demo has the full Zone 1 Story mission in Adventure, Normal, and Hard difficulties. Demo players can play this mission in co-op, so it's a great opportunity for friends to try out Deadzone!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45207649/d0ab5b5ac271de53a9ad3bf67604d89a5e600097.jpg
 
Weapon Improvements
- Adjusted Knife quick melee animation
- Reloading a weapon will no longer cancel if the player throws a grenade or uses quick melee. After the action, the reload will finish from where it left off
- Modified the weapon swap to allow weapons to be swapped while aiming using Q/Gamepad Top Face Button.
 
Affixes
- Void Tendrils only connects to 3 enemies max
 
Perks and Items
- Blood Chemist now gives bonus damage based on the player's missing health percentage.
- Tourniquet item no longer prevent fatal damage.
 
Bots
- Laser Crawler's laser no longer pierces through objects.
- Adjusted Laser Crawler laser so it can be jumped over it.
- Adjusted crawler room in glass cannon mission to match that in the story mission.
 
General Gameplay
- Pings now show distance
 
Fixes
- Fixed an issue where missions would sometimes show incorrectly as incomplete.
- Fixed an issue where the checkmark would sort above the tooltip panel on mission select.
- Fixed an issue where currency pickups wouldn't smoothly tumble to joining players on collection.
- Fixed several issues where the Flamethrower bot was dealing damage when it shouldn't.
- Fixed an issue where the minigun's SFX would get stuck on in co-op.
- Fixed Duel Dual final room dropping a primary weapon.
- Fixed bug where if you were hosting and the joining client got frozen, you would not see the freeze - mesh disappear after the freeze effect ended.
- Fixed a bug where chain lightning spawned by the host would not be visible by clients past the first bounce.
- Fixed an edge-case where a bot (i.e. Ranged Phalanx) could instantly swap targets while in the middle of firing.
- Fixed a bug where certain grenade types weren't identified as a grenade in their affix description.
- Fixed bug where, on rare occasions, aim assist would attempt to target an offscreen enemy while your crosshair was over a different enemy.
- Fixed an issue where weapon FOV was incorrect for widescreen.
- Fixed laughing gas super item always activating anytime you killed an enemy, instead of activating on a percent chance when you killed a debuffed enemy.

We hope you enjoy the update and the festival, good luck and have fun! Thanks so much for supporting us during early access!

- Prophecy Team

notes.title: Balance Updates, Bug Fixes, and a Tougher Nightmare.
notes.notes:
Patch Notes - Version 0.2.0.3

Steam Deck Support

Settings have reset to support optimal settings specific to Steam Deck.
Dev Note - Steam Deck settings were falling back to PC configurations. This has been addressed and settings reset only for Steam Deck users to support these.
Mission Updates

Split side missions into Specialty and Challenge missions.
Challenge missions on Nightmare now have more unique and challenging bot spawns.
Glass Cannon

Removed the partial healing and shield modifier.
Removed Shield damage spillover protection.
Enemies now deal 100% more damage to the player.
Perk Improvements

Renamed Shockwave to High Voltage.
Reduced Snowdrift nearby enemy damage to 25%, reduced overall Cryo damage to 20%.
Increased Blizzard tick damage from 20 to 60.
Increased Fire damage bonus on Inferno from 10% to 15%.
Increased bonus damage duration on Orbital Infusion to 8 seconds.
Item Update

Removed Fortune Cookie Super Item.
Dev Note - This item is undergoing a redesign.
Weapon Balance

Grenades now go through friendly players.
Reimplemented Weapon Inspects.

Defaulted to "I" on keyboard.
Defaulted to Right D-Pad on controller.

Iron Squires

No longer deals self damage.
Missed shots now increase spread by 10%.

Headhunter

No longer deals self damage.

BP-44 Harrier

Damage increased from 22 to 24.
Time Between Bursts lowered from .3 to .275.

T30 Nova Burst

Damage increased from 21 to 22.
Lowered Damage Falloff Penalty.

Sidekick-3 AP

Increased Damage from 35 to 39.

PR14x Aeos

Increased Damage from 31 to 32.

BAS-24 Warden

Increased Damage from 24 to 30.

Affixes

Lifesteal Affix now has a chance to heal you for a percentage of your max health whenever you deal damage with the affixed weapon.

Bot Changes

Adjusted the Melee Phalanx hit timing to be more accurate with the animation.
Adjusted several bots' weakpoints to be easier to hit.
Updated the Mesmerizer's look.
Ranged shielded enemies can now take AOE damage.
Removed Nyxis from later parts of Zone 2.
Removed Man-Spider from Zone 2 story mission.

DeadEye

Properly gets hit by explosions and counts as a headshot.
Increased head size when detached from the body.

Cryo Guardian

Reduced freeze shot radius by 15%.

Void Spiders

Reduced AOE of their void explosion by 30%.

Healing Drones

Reduced health by 50%.
Healing drones are limited to only 1 in a room in Adventure, Normal, and Hard difficulties.

Fire Mindless

Removed DOT fire damage.

Radiation Exploder

Removed radiation debuff.

Lightning Axe

Adjusted teleport so it will not teleport within certain distances, based on difficulty.

General Gameplay

Added aim assist settings for Off/Limited/On.
Adjusted the exit doors to an encounter to auto open at 30 seconds instead of 10 if loot orbs are not taken.
Fixes

Fixed an issue where the player could get a permanent black screen overlay if they jumped into death pits multiple times.
Fixed an issue where players in co-op would sometimes spawn underneath the Safe Room or in the next encounter, softlocking the run.
Fixed an issue where Lightning Axe bots could teleport when frozen.
Fixed an issue where bots could jump while frozen.
Fixed an issue where Nyxis Root was invisible to clients.
Fixed an issue where Phalanx could damage players at incorrect times after being staggered or frozen.
Fixed an issue where Headhunter would sometimes not refund a bullet when you scored a headshot.
Fixed an issue where damage from Ignite was not being affected by certain items that boosted proc damage.
Fixed damage bonus from Health Perk Child 3 not properly scaling with overhealing amount.
Fixed an issue where item effect UI for Alien's Hand Super Item would not update correctly when you swapped weapons or picked up a new weapon.
Fixed an issue where Alien's Hand would not correctly cap damage boost to 50%.
Fixed an issue where Steroid Tablets Super Item would not display its current damage boost in the UI on being equipped, and would only do so after taking damage/being healed.
Fixed an issue where Nitroglycerin Power Super Item would not correctly display the magnitude of its damage boost after you reload.
Fixed a bug where Hot Sauce Super Item would not display its current damage boost in the UI on being equipped, and would only do so after taking damage/being healed.
Fixed Recycled Plastic Super Item not clearing its damage boost when you picked up a new weapon.
Fixed Boomerang Super Item not refunding shots that hit doors.
Fixed Probability Cube and Hammer of the Artisan's Forge items not applying their effects to weapons picked up after the item was equipped on the joining client in co-op.
Fixed Plastic Wand, Tourniquet, and Barbed Grenade items not working for the joining client in co-op.
Fixed an issue where the Zone 2 teleporter did not show its exiting VFX.
Fixed several collision issues in the Starting Ship, Zone 1, and Zone 2.
Fixed several issues where bots could spawn inside geometry.
Fixed an issue where in-game music would be muffled if you quit to the main menu, went to the starting ship, then started a level without ever pausing.
Fixed an issue with weapon FOV when playing in widescreen.

notes.title: Updates to Glass Cannon & Headhunter Missions, Plus Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
Patch Notes: Version 0.1.1.1

Balance Improvements

Glass Cannon Mission
- Added Shield Break Prevention.
- Increased base health to 300.
- Removed Cryo and Void Spiders.
- Removed Spawner Bots.
- Removed Ranged Shielded Bots.
- Removed the Health Perks.

Headhunter Mission
- Non-Weakpoint hits now do reduced damage, and no longer do self-damage.

Affixes
- Damage boosts from Scrap Damage affix is capped at 10%.

Fixes
- Fixed a soft lock in Zone 2 that would occur when the Spawner bots would die the moment they were finishing fabricating a new bot.
- Fixed an issue where spam clicking while a progressive reload was active would cause your weapon to play a blend out animation over and over again instead of fully terminating the reload.
- Fixed an issue where the Mesmerizer FX would also show on other co-op player's HUDs.
- Fixed an issue where progressive reloads could be terminated early by spam clicking immediately after starting a reload.
- Fixed an issue where inviting platform friends to a custom lobby would show up as "Player Name."
- Fixed an issue where the gamma settings would not save after exiting and relaunching the game.
- Fixed an issue with Steam Deck where the thumbstick drift would cause players to stay in cursor mode.
- Fixed an issue where waiting notification would always read "waiting to travel to zone 1" in co-op.

notes.title: Progression and balance improvements, plus major bug fixes
notes.notes:
Patch Notes: Version 0.1.0.7

Balance Improvements

Progression
- Doubled Tech rewards from Missions
- Improved Component drop quantities

Bots
- Reduced Zone 2 Story mission bot damage slightly
- Reduced damage by about 30% for radiation Flying Exploders
- Removed Constructor Bots that created Flying Explosive Bots from the early parts of the Zone 2 Story mission and removed them from the Glass Cannon mission
- Constructor Bots that created Flying Explosive Bots now only create the standard version of them (from Zone 1), not the Radiation enhanced Zone 2 versions
- Removed the extra laser crawler spawn from the Zone 2 flooded area

Items
- The Monocle Item now grants +20% damage while aiming in addition to its movement speed boost
- Liquid Oxidizer Super Item now reloads 1 bullet at minimum

Fixes
- Fixed an issue where a crate would spawn in front of the door in the Brig area of Zone 1, blocking access to the orb.
- Fixed an issue where a rare feature would cause a hole to form in the floor in Zone 2.
- Fixed an issue where the Zone 2 Boss would be stuck in its shielded state
- Fixed an issue where refunding tech upgrades would not give the full amount of tech back
- Fixed an issue where the Headhunter mission had an empty augment slot
- Fixed an issue where Prepared Bot would not apply the correct pet bot respawn time bonus
- Fixed an issue where the Short Range augments would not apply their affects correctly when equipped by the joining client in coop
- Fixed an issue where bonuses from Probability Cube and Hammer of the Artisan's Forge would not stack if you had multiple versions of the same item


Thanks all! More fixes and patches will be coming up, good luck and have fun :)

- Prophecy Team

notes.title: Bug Fixes for Early Access
notes.notes:
Patch notes - Version 0.1.0.6

Thanks everyone for your feedback as part of early access! This patch fixes several of the most important and frequent bugs reported so far, fixes are listed below: 

Loot
- Removed physic bounces from loot orbs. They will now spawn static as to not cause problems like falling into pits of despair.

- In co-op, loot orbs will now only be visible to their owner.

- Fixed several issues with loot orbs where they would spawn in the following room, causing a soft lock.

- Fixed an issue in Pinpoint where no loot drops would spawn.

Items
- Sparkplug now reloads at least one bullet at minimum.

Bots
- Fixed an issue where the Man-Spider and Zone 2 boss effects were getting stuck on indefinitely.

Miscellaneous
- Fixed several typos in several descriptions and voice line subtitles.

Appreciate everyone's support, and if you see more bugs or have feedback, let us know anytime in the Discord (discord.gg/deadzonerogue) in the #feedback channel! Good luck, have fun.

- Prophecy Team

notes.title: Deadzone: Rogue Demo Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Co-Op

To play Co-Op, you will need to link your Epic account (this is for peer-to-peer online services)
Find the Co-Op terminal in the starting ship.
After interacting with it and clicking “Connect,” it will open a new tab to link your Epic account.
After connecting, you can either Host or Join a Lobby
To Host, create a lobby link, and share it with your friends
To Join a Lobby, copy and paste the Host’s Lobby Code in the Join Lobby Code text box
Reviving in Co-Op
In order to revive fallen teammates, any player(s) left alive will need to finish clearing the current room. Fallen team members will spawn back in.
Each teammate has a maximum of 2 revives

Masteries

Mastery Tiers are now one purchase per tier
